provenance.post_title: Delve into Gauntlight Keep on D&D Beyond!
provenance.asset_description: A banner with three columns of images and text. The first column is a ghostly woman screaming angrily, under her image is text that says: Ghastly Gauntlight, The very dungeon of Gauntlight Keep itself, holds great magic power, adding new dangers and the potential for greatness. The second column is of a dusty blue book with white scribbles on the cover and loose papers shoved between the pages, under the book reads: Mysterious Magic Items. 16 new magic items to liberate from Belcorra's keep. The third column is an image of a large worm-like creature with dozens of short insect legs and two tails, each holding a sharp weapon. Under the creature says, Haunting Horrors, over 90 monsters through 10 levels of megadungeon!
